title: so NOT impressed!
text:
so NOT impressed!. With a multitude of cats and 2 dogs in the house I really really wanted to like this vaccum but it's just not living up to my expectations.

PROS:
- bagless recepticle is super easy to use (remove, dump and replace).
- reusable filter - just wash and reuse (love that feature)
- attachments are great for cleaning pet hair from furniture
- really lightweight so not a big deal to have to pack up and down the stairs.

CONS:
- I got shocked every single time I pulled the vaccum toward or away from me. I really don't know why it's doing this unless it's transmitting static charge from the carpet but I've never had that happen before with any other vaccum I've used.
- After vaccuming you can still see dirt on the floor you just went over - and it didn't matter how many times I went back over it, it would just move the dirt about.
- when snapping the vaccum back into the upright position there's alot of resistance and I felt like I was going to break it.
- dirt is blown out around the hole where the hose attaches to the unit at the bottom.

I'm guessing for the price this is a decent vaccum (and I don't see anybody else mentioning the 'shock' factor so maybe it's just something with the unit I received (I had my husband and son try it and both were zapped as well) but I don't think I'll be using it. Maybe I'll see if the attachments will work with my other vaccum.
